quest.title: Matsumoto's Fried Egg Fracas
quest.description: Narukami Island's Matsumoto would like to have 5 servings of Teyvat Fried Egg.

talks.objective: Give five Teyvat Fried Eggs to Matsumoto

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I offer you a nice Teyvat Fried Egg...

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Aha, you must have seen my commission. You know, I've been to both Uyuu Restaurant and Kiminami Restaurant, and I was underwhelmed.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: I think that the really talented chefs must be hiding out of sight. That's why I posted a commission.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: If you're here, it must surely mean that you've got 5 Teyvat Fried Eggs for me?

response.speaker: Matsumoto
response.text: Oh. Then please bring them to me when they're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Good, then I will sample your cooking. I hope it won't disappoint me.
